ba0e3fa8ed.why: The xmm15 copy, both stores, and both XORs are required, with no shorter SSE2 form for these outputs.

f5d30f16fb.why: All three loaded values, both pointer advances, and both XOR results are required, leaving no removable instruction under SSE2.

fcdf794eed.why: The AES result, store, register copies, pointer advance, and subtraction with its carry flag are all required.

2a44ceeca2.why: Only xmm0 must retain its zeroed value; the clears of xmm1, xmm2, and xmm3 are dead after preserving the store of the original xmm2.

fd96e5829c.why: The input copy must survive in xmm4 while xmm2 is XORed with the separately preserved key load; the other loads and rcx advance are also required.
